title: facets is missing from SearchParameters types

comments.body:
This is the patch that we had to apply:

```diff
diff --git a/index.d.ts b/index.d.ts
index cd259e090441e6efc45c49fb0d4cee979545b750..576be59f2c499b04db16f0c0632503087a626f6e 100644
--- a/index.d.ts
+++ b/index.d.ts
@@ -411,7 +411,23 @@ declare namespace algoliasearchHelper {
      */
     hierarchicalFacets?: SearchParameters.HierarchicalFacet[];
 
+    // https://www.loom.com/share/60382a8ef084405e8d9e8b03db9f99e7
+    // https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5715
+    attributesToHighlight?: string[];
+
+    // https://www.loom.com/share/60382a8ef084405e8d9e8b03db9f99e7
+    // https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5715
+    attributesToRetrieve?: string[];
+
+    // https://www.loom.com/share/60382a8ef084405e8d9e8b03db9f99e7
+    // https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5715
+    hitsPerPage?: number;
+
     // Refinements
+    // https://contra-work.slack.com/archives/C016ND05C2Z/p1687978374777379
+    // https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5715
+    facets?: string[];
+
     /**
      * This attribute contains all the filters that need to be
      * applied on the conjunctive facets. Each facet must be properly
```
These and more are part of the SearchOptions type, how did you trigger the error? running typescript on the source code of algoliasearch-helper or something else? a reproduction would be interesting!

> These and more are part of the SearchOptions type, how did you trigger the error? running typescript on the source code of algoliasearch-helper or something else? a reproduction would be interesting!

They are part of `SearchOptions`, but they are missing from `PlainSearchParameters`, which is what the constructor of various components and hooks are using.
Do you have a sandbox or typescript playground that shows the usage which is not working? PlainSearchParameters extends SearchOptions, so we wouldn't need to rewrite every key I thought

@Haroenv hope it helps

https://www.loom.com/share/60382a8ef084405e8d9e8b03db9f99e7

https://www.loom.com/share/58887548fc774e25a8811813edaea13f

This is from our earlier debugging

Oh, I think this is fixed by upgrading to the latest version of algoliasearch-helper, 3.13.2 (or 3.13.3). As not all files are shown I'm not sure which version you used, but the error seems too familiar to https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/943 for it to be something else.
I'll close the issue now, as this likely was the problem, don't hesitate to reach out with a reproduction in case it wasn't!
